name: 缇塔
evolution: 缇塔 → 声波缇塔 Lv.40
description: 总是扫描寻找着什么，明明对洛克抱有极大的好奇，但是因为其机器守则限制，只能和洛克保持在一个不远不近的距离。“既可靠又实用，深得洛克们青睐，是您寻物时的不二之选。”
descriptionEn: Always scanning and searching for something. Although it is extremely curious about Roco, its machine code restricts it to keeping a not-too-close, not-too-far distance from them. 'Reliable and practical, favored by Roco, your best choice when searching for items.'

skills.name: 拆卸
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 杠杆置换
skills.description: 自己回复2能量，交换两侧技能位置。
skills.descriptionEn: Restores 2 energy to self, swaps the positions of both adjacent skills.

skills.name: 传感器
skills.description: 造成物伤，2连击，本技能位于1号或3号位时连击+1，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 2 hits; when in slot 1 or 3 hits +1, transmission 1.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Damage reduction 70%, responding to an attack.

skills.name: 取念
skills.description: 每回合随机变成敌方任意精灵的技能，且该技能能耗-2。
skills.descriptionEn: Each turn randomly becomes one of the enemy's skills, and that skill's energy cost -2.

skills.name: 啮合传递
skills.description: 自己获得速度+30，本技能位于1号或3号位时额外获得物攻+80%，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains Speed+30; when this skill is in slot 1 or 3, additionally gains Attack+80%, transmission 1.

skills.name: 主轴
skills.description: 造成物伤，此技能位置不会改变。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; this skill's position does not change.

skills.name: 齿轮扭矩
skills.description: 造成物伤，每回合位置发生变化时，本技能威力永久+15。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; each turn the position changes, this skill's power permanently +15.

skills.name: 轴承支撑
skills.description: 主动：本技能被动永久额外-1能耗，被动：两侧技能能耗-1，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Active: this skill's passive gains permanent extra -1 energy cost; passive: both adjacent skills' energy cost -1, transmission 1.

skills.name: 齿轮切开
skills.description: 造成物伤，本技能位于1号或3号位时能耗-2，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when in slot 1 or 3 energy cost -2, transmission 1.

skills.name: 快速移动
skills.description: 自己获得速度+80，应对防御：改为速度+160。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains Speed+80; when responding to defense: becomes Speed+160.

skills.name: 阻断
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：额外打断被应对技能。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; when responding to a status: additionally interrupts the responded skill.
